title: Preserve authority and lifecycle semantics when consolidating runtime concepts
summary: Share mechanisms with real consumer adoption and measured gates, while keeping authentication, scope placement, quota algorithms and lock rollout semantics explicit.
reusable_steps: Share mechanisms with real consumer adoption and measured gates, while keeping authentication, scope placement, quota algorithms and lock rollout semantics explicit
expected_outcome: Actor context is attribution, not an authorization grant: re-resolve canonical authority on read. Schema-backed state transactions must validate existing data and keep synchronous mutation under one canonical mutex. A lock-identity change requires stopping old writers before upgrade. Do not convert weighted token buckets to fixed windows or widen generated operation unions to reduce type counts. Bounded quotas for untrusted keys must reject overflow rather than evict live denied buckets. Check harness adoption must update the exact CI invocation; verify actual source startup to catch catalog/secure-io bootstrap cycles. Use per-file AST budgets plus duplicated type names and sites, with tests for destructuring and serialization aliases. Keep outstanding rollout criteria visible instead of calling a new helper global adoption.
